facts.value: The unique two-year, full-time joint Master of Science in the Psychology of Global Mobility, Inclusion and Diversity in Society (Erasmus Mundus) equips students to understand and address the challenges of diversity and mobility in our societies.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Psychology of Global Mobility, Inclusion and Diversity in Society, Erasmus Mundus - MSc

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: University of Limerick, ISCTE – University Institute of Lisbon, University of Oslo, SWPS University

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Access international research and career possibilities in intercultural relations, human rights, migration, and global development.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Learn to manage contemporary social and societal issues in an innovative, evidence-based, reflective, culturally sensitive and sustainable way.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Develop intercultural knowledge and research in social, cultural and health psychology at two European universities.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Choose from pathways that will lead you to Poland, Norway, Portugal and Ireland. There are two pathways – Culture and Diversity (Path A) and Inclusion and Health (Path C).

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Complete a 300-hour internship and apply your skills in real-world settings.
